author: root gpt-6.1-sol/ultra; positive redesign before independent fullcost acceptance
unique_candidate: R2: in-place bank preparation with separately transferred commit/W/B ownership
scope: INCR64/nonATOP, immutable context during finite validAXI run; normalTL success/fault; supplied W payload, finite fair downstream. Not actualDMA fault-job liveness or production reset/invalidation support.
goal: Find full logicalstate/port saving at the same early normalpermission preparation capability; no new payload/returnoracle. Distinct useful action may justify entry only if ordinaryB5 cannot reproduce it.

architecture.bank_cell_store: 2banks*4cells; full raw header exactly once percell; phaseunion can hold prepared physical header within raw width. This replaces private FIFO cell access architecture, not a preexisting native randomaccess port.
architecture.bank_lifetime: allocation and preparation indices separate; perbank accept-order release; globalAWreferences point only to resident cells; preparation owner names immutable active cell until response accepted.
architecture.global_raw_order: 8 raw/prepared bank-cell references; acceptedAW appended; dequeue at actual completeheader transfer into nativeAWspill, not claiming externalAW authorization.
architecture.global_held_commit: separate active/bank/error-target record after transfer; this owns the commit obligation while native spill owns full header. Only one unresolved handed-offAW globally; no younger header injected until actual DDRphysicalAW or error-sinkAW endpoint handshake. Avoid accidental totalAWcap8: 8resident bankcells plus separate handedoff head remain legal.
architecture.W_route: paid8-entry bank-tag FIFO, independent of globalAWorder; push acceptedvirtualAW, pop only true inputvirtualWLAST. Do not assume a free tap into upstreammux internal source selection. This replaces original samebank w_open selector so crossbankAW can be accepted early.
architecture.native_W_owners: bankW16+twoentry internalWspill, perbank targetselection/order and shared physicalWowner8; every ownership layer retires only at its own realWLAST. Native physicalW may progress after committedAW firstoffer evenbefore AWREADY; readpermission certificates still distinguish actual externalAW acceptance.
architecture.native_B: retain original fullID inputbankcredit tracking, perbank nativeerror/success targetbinding and nativeBspills. SameID targetchanges wait until older responses captured into orderedBspill; true sourceB retirement releases upstreamcredit. Do not allocate artificial8B debt or force60fullrecords if existing native trackers suffice.
architecture.read_path: unchanged B1/B1v/Mode7 or paid complete return reservation; orderedAWalone never grants futureAR. Actual current matching externalAW acceptance and full readID/epoch/offset obligations remain.
architecture.ports: perbank up to2combinational fullheader read views (prepare and commit); one cell update/capture port perbank, NormalTLresponse wins conflicts and incomingAWbackpressures; no free arbitraryFIFO extraction. Shared normalTLrequest/response1; globalrawAW capture1 and committransfer1; originalW/B/R data ports paid.
architecture.native_READ_WRITE_owner: Retain existing nativeREAD controller/AR rawhead/request/response state as common paid logic. Perbank WRITEprepare phase is mutually exclusive with nativeREAD REQ/AWAIT/COMPLETE ownership; WRITE can start only when nativeREAD is IDLE and blocked from simultaneous READ selection. Responsebank echo routes to this exclusiveowner; no extra2WRITE+2READ contexts.
architecture.preserved_virtual_metadata: Overwriting rawAW IOVA is legal only after NormalTL handshake and after any virtual-span/job/epoch/readcertificate consumer owns needed fields in a declared paid record. Existing Mode7 rawAW/AR/job metadata remains charged to both; four-source extension is not claimed current implementation. If absent, both pay exact required fields/ports before use; physicaladdress is not a free inverse of IOVA.

events.name: virtualAW_accept
events.guard: free targetbankcell AND raw-order reference space AND Wroute credit AND full-ID upstream debt credit AND metadata writeport available
events.ownership: capture immutable full header/source context, clear ready/error for allocatedcell, appendcellref and Wbanktag; source owns heldAW until actual handshake

events.name: NormalTL_firstVALID
events.guard: oldest unprepared resident cell of bank, nativeowner free; copy-check boundary guard; sharedTLfirstoffer selected stable; nativeREADcontroller IDLE and simultaneous READselection blocked, at most one NormalTLowner of eitherkind perbank
events.ownership: bankprepare cursor names cell; cell and request fields remain immutable until response transfer; roundrobin lock paid

events.name: NormalTL_req_handshake
events.ownership: one WAITresponse owner perbank; NormalTL bank echo selects exactly that owner
events.release: TLrequest outputhold ends; cell remains owned

events.name: NormalTL_resp_handshake
events.guard: matchingbank WAITowner AND responseVALID AND cell writeport; invalid/missingowner rejects response
events.ownership: success writes actualphysicaladdr plus required physical attrs in samecell, fault sets stableerror/target; complete normalresponse owner transferred to readycell
events.release: request-only raw IOVA/DID/PID fields may be reclaimed; bankowner retires; no generation needed in frozen no-cancel scope sincecell cannotfree while TLpending and response consumed exactlyonce; any still-needed virtualaddr/span is already in an independently owned paid record, otherwise rawaddr is retained in additional charged storage

events.name: nativeAWspill_transfer
events.guard: no globalheldcommit AND raworderhead ready AND nativeAW/selectionspill bothaccept full stableheader/target
events.ownership: full physical/error header andtarget move to native pairedspills; globalheld active/bank/target becomes sole unresolved endpoint obligation
events.release: raworderhead ref popped; bankcell raw/result may immediately free after acceptedcomplete copy; W/B ownership remains elsewhere

events.name: endpointAW_firstVALID
events.guard: corresponding nativecut head and target credit; globalheld is sole eligiblehead; sharedoutputmux successfulAW retains order
events.ownership: native target owner and sharedoutput AW/W firstofferlocks; no cancellation/change while VALIDheld

events.name: endpointAW_handshake
events.guard: actual successful external AWfire OR actual matching error-sink AWfire
events.ownership: endpoint receives immutable identity/len/attributes and futureW obligation; globalcommit ledger advances
events.release: globalheld record; no rawcell lookup after transfer, no stalecellref use

events.name: virtualW_last_handshake
events.guard: Wroute current bank and actually supplied legal W payload; acceptedAWowner exists, targetWfifo available
events.ownership: all data including LAST copied into paidbankW FIFO/nativepipeline; sourceWselect and virtualWbanktag retire
events.release: only virtual route entry; not real sinkWdone/Bdone

events.name: native_targetW_last_handshake
events.guard: success/error route committed by nativefirstoffer; actual WVALID/READY/LAST at target
events.ownership: successful sink consumes finaldata or errorsink drops finaldata then ownsSLVERR; nativeWowners retire

events.name: cutB_capture
events.guard: normal sink returns fulloriginalID or errorsink producedSLVERR after realW consume, nativeBspill has room
events.ownership: B identity/response migrates into ordered2entry nativeBspill; cut-side sameID target credit may release
events.release: not upstreamB credit; actual response remains owned until onward handshake

events.name: sourceB_handshake
events.guard: oldest stable nativeB output for that fullID accepted by original source path
events.ownership: master consumesB, source/job counter completion semantics remain original
events.release: upstream fullID debt; Brecord no longer owned; never use WLAST alone to releaseB

inductive_invariants: Every acceptedAW has exactly one raw/preparedcell or complete-header handoff copy and commit ledger until endpointAW consumed.
GlobalFIFO cellref is consulted only before nativeAWtransfer; after transfer heldledger observes endpoint and never dereferences a freed/reallocatedcell.
WAIT NormalTL owner always names a valid unpreparedcell, so no acceptedresponse can write reused storage; reuse after response+handoff needs no generation in this exact scope.
Each fullheader firstVALID is backed by immutable owned cell/spill; selection/order remains fixed through handshake.
All actual endpointAW issue decisions follow accepted order, error targets included; merely placing successive headers in differentbankspills is insufficient and forbidden.
VirtualWroute FIFO and nativephysicalWowners are independent; virtualLAST only transfers data ownership, it cannot declare actual errorW/B complete.
For sameID, oldtargetB must be ordered/captured before native target changes; any captured B stays ahead in nativeBspill, while upstream credit remains until actual originalsourceB.
Every nativecapacity and port conflict is enforced; bank4+4 is not a shared8capacity, Wroute8 is not B debt8, no additional result-header or payload memory is free.

Perbank native READowner and WRITEprepare owner never overlap; NormalTL response bank identifies exactly one current owner kind. Original AR request/result/metadata capacity is still charged, not silently removed.

resource_encoding_initial.raw_cells_formula: 8*Hraw bits; Hraw/production verified independently in control cost envelope
resource_encoding_initial.bank_ring_indices_and_occupancy_bits: 2banks*(head2+tail2+prepare2+occupancy3)=18; valid membership derived from ring bounds, not extra free slotbitmap
resource_encoding_initial.bank_TL_phase_bits: 2banks*2phasebits=4; prepareindex is owner reference and stays fixed while REQ/WAIT
resource_encoding_initial.shared_TL_merge_state_bits: roundrobin1+locked1+heldbank1=3; request fields remain in ownedcells; actual mux/comparison/fanout ports separately paid
resource_encoding_initial.not_total_area: All retained nativecell/queue/spill/data/metadata/TL/R/B/software costs must be represented as common terms plus candidate-specific typed state and ports. Native physical implementation results null.
resource_encoding_initial.common_terms: NativeREAD/AR req/result/FSM/early metadata, original source metadata/job/FIFO, error/success binding/spills/Bcredit trackers, bankW/commondata, sharedPTW/NormalTL, and software costs retained identically. Original nativeAW rawFIFO cells/control are replaced by declared new cellstore/rings and never counted again in common.
resource_encoding_initial.status: initial design encoding retained, refined chosen reference after independentcostgate in full-cost-comparison.json

cost_hypothesis: In-place raw/prepared union avoids a second fullheader store relative to a naive duplicated preparation queue. Strong ordinaryB5 may equally union and use phase-specific ownership; not claimed independent saving before independent envelope.
